integrity: Analytic proof and executable exact-integer finite regressions; originality is literature-limited and not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Scalar cyclic three-point median with unit edge variation; excludes larger windows, weighted or nonperiodic paths, vector data and multistep iteration. title: Sharp BV perturbation threshold for cyclic three-point medians
